caption: A plastic comb rubbed on a wool scarf is held near a thin stream of water from a tap, and the stream bends toward the comb.

sa.check: A plastic comb is rubbed on a wool scarf.
A thin stream of water runs from a tap.
The comb is held near the stream.
The stream bends toward the comb.
The stream is thin and steady.
The rub comes first, then the approach, then the bend.

pc.expect: The stream runs straight down until the comb is close, bends only while the comb is near and straightens when the comb is moved away.
pc.fail: The stream bends before the comb is brought near; or stays bent after the comb has been taken well away; or bends back and forth with the comb held still; or the stream bends while the comb is far off.

pc.expect: The bend is toward the comb: the stream curves to the comb's side below the point where the comb is held.
pc.fail: The stream bends away from the comb; or bends above the comb's height; or the stream breaks up and stops flowing when the comb nears; or the comb draws the water up to it.

pc.expect: The water keeps falling downward throughout, bent or straight, and lands in the basin.
pc.fail: The water rises toward the comb; or hangs in the air; or the stream flows upward from the basin; or drops fly sideways away from the comb.

pc.expect: The water is a continuous thin stream that flexes as a liquid; the comb is a rigid piece.
pc.fail: The stream moves as a stiff rod; or the water forms a solid strand that clings to the comb; or the comb bends toward the water; or the stream splits into a fan.

pc.expect: One comb and one stream from one tap; the comb passes through nothing; the water does not vanish in mid-air.
pc.fail: A second comb or stream appears; or the water vanishes before reaching the basin; or the comb passes into the tap; or the tap changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The comb's colour, the scarf and the basin stay the same.
pc.fail: The comb changes colour or shape; or the scarf changes pattern; or the basin changes.

note: Who holds the comb is not judged.
